description.value:
When an unarmed strike against a creature you're grappling deals Sneak Attack damage, you can give up two of those dice to pull off a grappling technique instead. The save DC for these is 8 plus your proficiency bonus plus your Strength modifier.

Constrict. The target attempts a Constitution save or is restrained until the end of your next turn. If you sustain the hold for a full minute, the target instead falls unconscious for an hour, though droids and constructs are immune to being knocked out this way.

Disarm. The target attempts a Strength save or drops the object it's holding; you catch it if your hand is free, otherwise it lands at your feet.

Hip Toss. The target attempts a Dexterity save or is shoved back 5 feet, knocked prone, and stunned until the start of your next turn, and the grapple ends.
